nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a discrete valuation ring with residue field $k$, and let $g \in A[X]$ be a monic polynomial whose reduction $\bar g \in k[X]$ modulo the maximal ideal of $A$ is irreducible. If $A[X]/(g)$ is an integral domain and a local ring, then $A[X]/(g)$ is a discrete valuation ring.
nodes.title: Monic lifts of irreducible residue polynomials give DVRs

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a local ring with residue field $k$, and let $g \in A[X]$ be a polynomial whose reduction $\bar g \in k[X]$ modulo the maximal ideal of $A$ is irreducible. If $A[X]/(g)$ is a local ring, then the canonical map $A \to A[X]/(g)$ is a local ring homomorphism: an element of $A$ whose image in $A[X]/(g)$ is a unit is itself a unit.
nodes.title: Local base map for polynomials with irreducible reduction

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a local ring with residue field $k$, and let $g \in A[X]$ be a monic polynomial whose reduction $\bar g \in k[X]$ modulo the maximal ideal of $A$ is irreducible. Then $A[X]/(g)$ is a local ring.
nodes.title: Monic polynomials with irreducible reduction give local rings

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a local ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$ and residue field $k$, and let $g \in A[X]$ be a polynomial whose reduction $\bar g \in k[X]$ modulo $\mathfrak m$ is irreducible. Then the ideal of $A[X]/(g)$ generated by the image of $\mathfrak m$ under the canonical map $A \to A[X]/(g)$ is maximal.
nodes.title: The extended maximal ideal is maximal for irreducible reduction

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a local ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$ and residue field $k$, let $g \in R[X]$, and let $\bar g \in k[X]$ be a polynomial equal to the reduction of $g$ modulo $\mathfrak m$. nodes.title: Reducing $R(X)/(g)$ modulo the maximal ideal of $R$

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a discrete valuation ring with residue field $k$, and let $L$ be a finite separable field extension of $k$. Then there is a discrete valuation ring $B$ with an $A$-algebra structure such that $B$ is finitely generated as an $A$-module and the structure map $A \to B$ is a local homomorphism, together with an isomorphism of $k$-algebras between the residue field of $B$ (a $k$-algebra via $A \to B$) and $L$.
nodes.title: Finite separable residue extensions lift to finite DVR extensions

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a discrete valuation ring with residue field $k$, and let $\bar g \in k[X]$ be monic and irreducible. Then there is a monic polynomial $g \in A[X]$ whose reduction modulo the maximal ideal of $A$ is $\bar g$, such that $A[X]/(g)$ is an integral domain and is finitely generated as an $A$-module.
nodes.title: Monic lifts of irreducible residue polynomials

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a local ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$ and residue field $k$, and let $g \in A[X]$ be a polynomial whose reduction $\bar g \in k[X]$ modulo $\mathfrak m$ is irreducible. If $A[X]/(g)$ is a local ring, then its maximal ideal is the ideal generated by the image of $\mathfrak m$ under the canonical map $A \to A[X]/(g)$.
nodes.title: The maximal ideal of $A(X)/(g)$ is extended from $A$

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
